title: gvc/bse: internal/jev only knows the work-type Choice; generalise it before bse classifies findings against [A<n>] items
body: bse's acceptance says it reuses the existing Jev client to classify a finding against an epic's own acceptance items plus 'none'. internal/jev is hard-wired to the five work types: fixed criteria in wire.go and results typed as runconfig.WorkType. bse needs a generic Choice over caller-supplied options with the same no-answer semantics, either in its own scope or as a tick in the wave before it (a vocabulary and its consumer belong in different waves).
